name: Sharmila Rege
shortBio: Indian feminist sociologist who theorized Dalit Feminist Standpoint epistemology, critiquing both savarna Indian feminism for erasing caste and mainstream sociology for ignoring Ambedkar’s radical archive.
centralQuestion: How does centering Dalit women’s lived experience of caste-patriarchal violence transform feminist standpoint epistemology and sociological canon formation?

keyWorks.title: Dalit Women Talk Differently: A Critique of Difference and Towards a Dalit Feminist Standpoint Position
keyWorks.description: Foundational formulation of Dalit feminist standpoint theory bridging Phule-Ambedkarite critique with standpoint epistemology.

keyWorks.title: Writing Caste, Writing Gender: Narrating Dalit Women’s Testimonios
keyWorks.description: Reconstructs Dalit women’s autobiographical testimonios as counter-hegemonic sociological theory.
